summary.headline: Pentagon AI war-data contract lifts Self-Destruction
summary.body: Military AI led the day. Accenture won a contract worth up to $821M to build a Pentagon 'War Data Platform' feeding more than 1,500 military data streams into AI tools, and Shield AI raised $1.5B for autonomous drones as defence-AI funding surged. Both raised Catastrophic Risk, the factor behind Self-Destruction, and gave a small lift to Conquerors, which also gains in a more militarised world. Pulling the other way, Hugging Face used a Chinese open model to analyse a cyberattack after US models refused, a sign that power is not locked up by a few labs; that lowers Enslaved God. A HarrisX poll found 56% of US voters view AI favourably, easing Tech Backlash, and a judge approved Anthropic's $1.5B authors' settlement. Horizon Balance fell to 0.69.
summary.movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.4 came mostly from the Accenture Pentagon contract (+0.33) plus Shield AI's raise (+0.05). Conquerors +0.1 followed the same two stories, and Enslaved God -0.1 tracked the Hugging Face open-model story (-0.09).

events.title: Judge approves Anthropic's $1.5B copyright settlement with authors
events.summary: A federal judge approved the $1.5 billion class settlement over books pirated for Claude training, about $3,000 per work; Anthropic must destroy pirated copies.
events.reason: Compensation to creators from AI gains; known story reaching final approval.

events.title: Poll: 56% of US voters view AI favorably
events.summary: A HarrisX poll of 2,011 voters, commissioned by pro-AI group Build American AI, found 56% favorable and 53% backing rapid development.
events.reason: Survey showing acceptance; sponsor is an industry advocacy group.

events.title: Hugging Face turns to Chinese open model after US models refused to help analyze attack
events.summary: Hugging Face used Z.ai's GLM 5.2 to analyse the cyberattack on it after closed US frontier models refused, fuelling the open-weights debate.
events.reason: Shows open (Chinese) weights gaining ground versus closed labs.

events.title: Accenture wins up to $821M Pentagon contract for AI 'War Data Platform'
events.summary: Accenture Federal Services won a five-year contract to build software feeding 1,500+ military data streams into Pentagon AI tools; CDAO credited the platform in the Iran campaign. Exact date is a Monday in July; July 20 is best estimate.

events.title: Defense-AI funding surges: Shield AI raises $1.5B at $12.7B valuation
events.summary: Autonomous-drone maker Shield AI raised a $1.5B Series G; roundups counted over $3B in defense AI funding in July including Helsing's round. Date approximate (reported July 20).
events.reason: Autonomous weapons funding; date and figures from roundup only.
